job.title: Software Engineer I
job.pay_full: $124,600 – $148,200 a year base pay, plus an annual incentive reference value of 15%

details.about: Coca-Cola's North America Operating Unit is rebuilding the digital products behind its customer journeys, service delivery, sales workflows and the platforms that connect them. Software engineers join small, empowered cross-functional teams with Product Management and Design. Depending on the team, the work could cover connected service tools, data and API platforms, customer and operational experiences, or sales products.
duties: Work with Product Management and Design to understand customer problems, and help with ideation, prototyping and weighing solutions
Guide the technical approach, architecture and system design for your product area, making pragmatic trade-offs
Deliver solutions that meet standards for performance, reliability, security and scalability, with strong testing, observability and CI/CD
Keep code quality high through reviews and hands-on work
Define and track success metrics with Product and Data, and use data, feedback and experiments to guide decisions
Help shape engineering standards and best practices across teams
needs: At least 2 years of software engineering experience
Experience building and shipping production-grade applications
Proficiency in modern frontend and backend languages and frameworks
Experience with APIs, distributed systems and cloud environments
Strong full stack skills and a product mindset
Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued
nice: Experience on cross-functional product teams and in product discovery or solution design
Technical leadership within a team, formal or informal
Exposure to data-driven, automation or AI-enabled systems
Enterprise platforms or large-scale distributed systems; customer-facing products
details.benefits: Base pay $124,600 – $148,200 a year (United States); base pay may vary with geography, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. Annual incentive reference value of 15%. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits is offered, depending on the position. Relocation is provided.
notes: Coca-Cola will not sponsor employment visas for this role; applicants must already be authorized to work in the US full time

scenes.head: About the team
lines: Coca-Cola's North America team is rebuilding the digital products behind its customer journeys, service tools, sales workflows, and the platforms that connect them.
You'd join a small product team, working side by side with product managers and designers, and you're expected to help solve problems, not just ship features.

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll help discover what to build, from early ideas and prototypes to weighing different approaches.
You'll guide the technical approach and system design for your product area, making smart trade-offs between speed, scale, and cost.
You'll deliver reliable, secure software with strong testing and continuous delivery, and keep code quality high through reviews.
And you'll track success with data and customer feedback.

scenes.head: What you need
lines: You'll need at least two years of software engineering and a record of shipping production applications.
Strong full stack skills across frontend and backend, plus experience with A P Is, distributed systems, and the cloud.
A bachelor's in computer science, engineering, or a related field is expected, and equivalent practical experience counts just as much.
Cross-functional team experience and a product mindset are a real plus.

lines: Base pay is one hundred twenty-four thousand six hundred to one hundred forty-eight thousand two hundred dollars a year, with an annual incentive reference value of fifteen percent.
Coca-Cola offers a range of medical, financial, and other benefits. Travel is up to a quarter of the time.
Note that the company won't sponsor work visas for this role.
